name: Tailoring
overview: The Scriptures reveal that tailoring, as demonstrated in the construction of the tabernacle garments, is a God-ordained skill endowed by the Spirit of God. Bezaleel and Aholiab were specifically called and filled with wisdom, understanding, and craftsmanship to create the holy garments for Aaron and his sons, enabling them to minister in the priestly office. These sacred garments, made from fine cloths of blue, purple, and scarlet, were crafted precisely according to the Lord’s command, highlighting the importance of skilled workmanship in service to God.
